title: Shoe retailer vanHaren hit by cyberattack, customer data leaked, company says
summary: Omroep Brabant reports that vanHaren says it was hit by a cyberattack in which customer data leaked, including names, addresses, invoices, email addresses, phone numbers and chosen payment method. The company says the incident is limited in scope, the security gap is closed, and login details, passwords and card numbers were not leaked. It has told the police and the Dutch data protection authority.
plain: Dutch shoe chain vanHaren says customer data leaked in a cyberattack, but not passwords or card numbers. It says the scope is limited and the gap is closed.
exec: A retailer says customer contact and order data leaked and it has notified police and the data protection authority.
action: vanHaren advises being wary of people posing as the company, checking where a message comes from and not clicking links in unexpected messages.

validation.note: Only Omroep Brabant read, quoting the company; the company notice was not read. Number affected not given there.
